# SpringBone

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpringBone")`

Makes a chain of joints swing and settle behind the body that carries it, for a cape, a tail, hair or a tassel. Parent it to the skinned `MeshPart` and set `RootJoint` to the joint the chain hangs from. The joints below it then move with the body, on top of the animation that is playing.

It is visual only. Each machine runs it at the frame rate after the animation is applied; it is not replicated or recorded in a replay, and a server with no window does not run it. Game logic should not read where the chain is.

A cape is typically three or four columns of four or five joints, skinned like any others. One `SpringBone` on the joint above all the columns moves every column.

Each joint keeps its distance from its parent, is pulled back toward its animated pose by `Stiffness`, and never bends more than `LimitAngle` from that pose. Add `SpringCollider`s under the same mesh to keep the chain out of the body.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Damping` | `number` | `0.2` | read/write | How much of its motion a joint loses each step, from 0 to 1. A low value swings for a long time; a high value settles quickly and looks heavy. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the chain is moved. When it is off, the joints return to their animated pose from the next frame. |
| `GravityScale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much of the world's gravity affects the chain. At 0 the chain floats; a negative value makes it rise. |
| `Inertia` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the chain lags behind the body's motion, from 0 to 1. At 1 a cape streams out behind a running character; at 0 it moves with the body as if there were no air. |
| `JointPattern` | `string` | — | read/write | A name pattern for the top joint of each chain, where `*` matches any run of characters. Every joint the pattern matches starts its own chain: `Cape_*0` matches the top of each column of a cape whose joints are named `Cape_L0`, `Cape_L1`, and so on. A matched joint that is below another matched joint belongs to that joint's chain. Use it with `RootJoint` or in place of it. |
| `LimitAngle` | `number` | `70` | read/write | The largest angle, in degrees, that a joint can bend away from its animated direction. |
| `Radius` | `number` | `0.05` | read/write | The thickness of the chain where it meets a `SpringCollider`, in the mesh's units. |
| `RootJoint` | `string` | — | read/write | The name of the joint the chain hangs from, as it is named in the model file. That joint stays where the animation puts it; every joint below it is moved. Nothing moves if the rig has no joint of that name. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `0.25` | read/write | How strongly each joint is pulled back toward its animated pose, from 0 to 1. At 0 the chain hangs like a rope; at 1 it does not move. |
| `WindInfluence` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the world's wind pushes the chain. At 0 the chain ignores wind. |
